propositions: _build_datacenter must assert non-secret scope readiness (base_url and project) at build time via BackendEnvError, mirroring _build_cloud's placement and behavior

assert_datacenter_nonsecret_scope_ready should validate only base_url and project presence, keeping JIRA_PAT and network validation lazy in _LazyDataCenterClient to preserve composability without the jira extra or PAT at build

assert_cloud_scope_ready's stricter checks (email-format JIRA_USER, non-empty project) are intentional and canonical, not accidental drift, and must be documented as deliberately tightening beyond legacy ambient assert_env_ready
datacenter backend construction must succeed without JIRA_PAT set and without importing the jira extra, verified by unit tests covering the lazy path

Cloud and DataCenter fail-closed validation scopes must be symmetric in structure (non-secret assertions at build, lazy full validation at client use) with documented rationale for intentional strictness differences
